quote: We've stayed at estates across the Mediterranean — Amalfi, Côte d'Azur, Mallorca. Casa Serena is the only one we've returned to three times.
name: James & Caroline H.

quote: The silence. That's what I remember most. No music piped through speakers, no lobby chatter. Just the wind, the sea, and the occasional clink of a wine glass.
name: Sophie M.

quote: My wife said 'I don't want to leave' on day two. We extended by a week. Nikos and his team made it feel effortless.
name: David & Rachel K.
